title: z8
description: Small survival Minecraft server. No whitelist, no economy, no pay-to-win.
body: Small survival Minecraft server running Folia 26.1.2. No whitelist, no economy, no pay-to-win. Just grab the IP and hop in, no application or approval needed. There's also a website with live player stats, a leaderboard, and a changelog if you want to check things out first.
